value: Cruel size game based on the titular character from the manga of the same name by Uru. Features shrinkable NPCs and Live2D animated size scenarios. (Current version contains 1 scenario)
You play as the Elf Princess, using her magic to torment humans by shrinking them, or growing giant. Time to Complete: <10 minutes

Your character can shrink any NPC or grow giant in any level. Shrunken characters can be stomped or grabbed and added to your inventory. Shrunken NPCs can be gifted to other characters to unlock cutscenes where they are toyed with.
